qpcr_dpcr.label: qPCR and digital PCR
qpcr_dpcr.definition: Quantifies nucleic acids by PCR, either from amplification curves read in real time (qPCR) or by counting positive partitions after endpoint amplification (digital PCR). One technology (Josh, 2026-11-05); the dPCR terms and brands are shown separately inside it.

flow_cytometry.label: Flow cytometry
flow_cytometry.definition: Measures fluorescence (or metal-tag) signals from single cells in a fluid stream to count, phenotype and sort them; includes spectral, imaging and suspension mass cytometry. Imaging mass cytometry of tissue is spatial proteomics.

ms_proteomics.label: Mass-spec proteomics
ms_proteomics.definition: Identifies and quantifies proteins by mass spectrometry, usually of digested peptides separated by liquid chromatography (bottom-up, DDA or DIA), sometimes of intact proteins (top-down). Includes mass-spec tissue and single-cell proteomics.

top_assignees: President and Fellows of Harvard College

affinity_proteomics.label: Affinity and single-molecule proteomics
affinity_proteomics.definition: Measures hundreds to thousands of proteins in blood or lysate with affinity reagents (antibody pairs, aptamers) read out by sequencing or fluorescence, or counts single protein molecules digitally. Low-plex immunoassays (ELISA, bead panels) are not counted.
affinity_proteomics.note: Nautilus (single-molecule proteome analysis) is pre-commercial; add at launch

protein_sequencing.label: Protein sequencing
protein_sequencing.definition: Reads the amino-acid sequence of single peptide or protein molecules directly, with fluorescent recognizers, fluorosequencing or nanopores. Edman degradation and de novo mass-spec sequencing are not counted.
protein_sequencing.note: Erisyon, Glyphic and Portal Biotech are pre-commercial; add when they ship

short_read_ngs.label: Short-read sequencing
short_read_ngs.definition: Sequences millions to billions of short DNA fragments (typically 50-300 bases per read) in parallel on a flow cell or chip, by synthesis, binding/avidity, or ion detection.

long_read_sequencing.label: Long-read sequencing
long_read_sequencing.definition: Sequences single DNA or RNA molecules thousands to millions of bases long, by real-time imaging of a polymerase (SMRT) or by ionic current through a nanopore.

single_cell.label: Single-cell genomics
single_cell.definition: Profiles RNA, chromatin, or surface proteins in thousands to millions of individual cells by partitioning them (droplets, wells) or by combinatorial barcoding, then sequencing.

spatial_transcriptomics.label: Spatial transcriptomics
spatial_transcriptomics.definition: Measures RNA expression with the tissue location preserved, either by capturing transcripts onto a spatially barcoded surface (sequencing-based) or by reading them in place with multiplexed in situ hybridization or sequencing (imaging-based).

spatial_proteomics.label: Spatial proteomics
spatial_proteomics.definition: Images many proteins in one tissue section with location preserved, by cyclic immunofluorescence, DNA-barcoded antibodies, or metal-tagged antibodies read by mass spectrometry.
